_comment: Cursor-format hook bundle for the two safety invariants. Declared by .cursor-plugin/plugin.json's `hooks` field, because Cursor's own component discovery defaults to hooks/hooks.json - which in this repo is the CLAUDE-format file, with PascalCase events Cursor cannot read. It runs the SAME scripts as Claude and Codex rather than forked copies: hooks/lib/hook-output.sh detects Cursor from the payload (conversation_id / cursor_version / workspace_roots) and emits {permission, user_message, agent_message} instead of hookSpecificOutput, and hooks/lib/write-targets.py already treats Cursor's `Shell` like `Bash`. Measured 2026-09-23 on cursor-agent 2026.07.17-3e2a980: preToolUse carries tool_name Read/Write/Shell with tool_input.file_path and tool_input.command - the same names and fields Claude uses for Read/Write, so no translation layer is needed. cursor-agent-tools-guard.sh additionally enforces each agent's frontmatter `tools:` list, which Cursor does not enforce itself; it needs postToolUse as well as preToolUse, to pop a subagent frame when its Task completes.
